case_order: fatigue, sleep, direction; ascending listed order
followup_selection: first two cases in protocol order with different requested-action traces, irrespective of energy outcome
followup_endpoint: four confirmed route landings or 64 total policy ticks, then up to four paid slow_breath pause ticks; pending original targets are retained
fixture: declared uniform channel-fatigue and sleep initial conditions on fresh synthetic defaults; record external_input; then unchanged six-tick prelude
screen_primary: decision relevance and actual requested-action divergence; fixed-time fuel is not an efficiency win if progress differs
followup_primary: both reach exactly four confirmed landings and a matching grounded double-support pause; compare prefix fuel debit and simulated time including pause; report failures and tradeoffs
dominance: comparable four-landing paused endpoints; no greater fuel debit or owner ticks and at least one strictly better; no full-route benefit claim
scope: prospective deterministic synthetic sensitivity survey; selected followup is conditional on divergence, not a population benefit estimate
